note: tapFrac is the normalised screen centre of a real RectTransform, computed from the canvas and not estimated. The menu canvas is Scale With Screen Size at reference 1242x2688 with ScreenMatchMode Expand, and the panels hang under an AspectRatioFitter locked to 1242/2688, so on a 1080x2400 device the canvas resolves to 1242x2760 with 36 units of letterbox top and bottom. For a rect centred at panel (x, y), origin at the panel centre and +y up: tapFracX = (621 + x) / 1242 and tapFracY = (1380 - y) / 2760.
